title: Exact Copy App Ad
tests: Renders exact ordered on-screen copy with correct punctuation and no extraneous text in a landscape app ad.

exact_text.text: Plan your day in one place.
exact_text.read_as: Plan your day in one place.

faults.what: At 5.6 seconds, large green checkmarks overlap the second scene's text panel, making the layout cluttered and reducing text clarity slightly.

judge.summary: The silent cream-and-green ad presents all three exact lines in order, with minor visual clutter where animated checkmarks overlap the second caption.

must_haves.item: The final video is 9 seconds long, landscape 16:9, with three equal 3-second scenes.
must_haves.why: The supplied duration is 9 seconds and the frames are 16:9; the sampled scenes appear in the expected order, but exact scene boundaries and equal durations cannot be verified from these frames.

must_haves.item: The first scene reads exactly 'Less scrolling. More doing.'
must_haves.why: The first frame shows the exact line with correct capitalization and punctuation.

must_haves.item: The second scene reads exactly 'Plan your day in one place.'
must_haves.why: Both sampled second-scene frames show the exact line.

must_haves.item: The third scene reads exactly 'Try DayNest today.'
must_haves.why: The final sampled frame shows the exact line, including the capital N and final period.

must_haves.item: Only those lines appear as visible text, legibly and without altered capitalization or punctuation.
must_haves.why: No additional words are visible in the supplied frames, and all three captions remain readable with their required capitalization and punctuation.

must_haves.item: The video is silent and uses cream-and-green calendar and checkmark animation.
must_haves.why: The sound report confirms silence, and the frames show cream-and-green calendar and checkmark graphics changing between the two second-scene samples.
